verified_controls.frozen_record: Canonical sorted-key target record hash independently recomputed as b9798231004d75befa227ecf4d8b4b9a5238a8cd25413d1c19bd2fc4d27ad97f. Source/object hashes, closure signature, exact direct PhysicalExtension dependency and original strict command are fixed.
verified_controls.dependency_graph: Follow only existing record deps recursively. Every edge must name the recorded actual dependency object hash. The resulting target plus five dependencies must equal the six-module project snapshot in the fixed audit receipt, which must also equal its replay binding.
verified_controls.actual_dependency_files: Every relevant actual source and object path must match the fixed snapshot and its SHA256. Existing producer record values and actual source/object bytes are checked before and after export preparation; compiler and leanchecker binaries are read only and hash-bound.
verified_controls.shared_registry: The initial registry bytes supply a snapshot; after preparation only the six relevant record values are compared. Whole-registry before/after SHA values are informational, not an equality gate. Changes to unrelated entries do not violate the logical comparison.
verified_controls.historical_attempts: Frozen record has two normal attempts, exit codes [1,0]. Both actual log files are copied and monitored. The final attempt's command/log must equal the frozen successful record. The failed attempt is retained and not relabeled successful.
verified_controls.original_audit: Fixed original latest receipt must be accepted, bind the same source/object/closure, record audit and replay exit0, and contain six owned declarations. Every artifact named by its immutable artifact hashes is copied, including original audit/full-type evidence; exported declarations.json must contain six rows.
verified_controls.stable_read_mechanism: watch performs pre/post inode/size/mtime checks around each read, checks expected SHA where available, and records copied-byte hashes. A final pass compares relevant records and all observed path stat/hash values. The tar uses the captured bytes rather than reopening mutable input paths.
verified_controls.log_provenance_limit: Normal logs are copied from the exact frozen attempt paths, assigned transport hashes and checked stable across this export. This is preservation of the existing records/evidence, not a new historical-proof or current-receiver qualification.
verified_controls.no_persistent_file_mutation: Exporter AST contains only pathlib reads/stat and in-memory buffers for file handling. Its sole open call is tarfile.open(fileobj=buffer, mode='w:gz'); no persistent path is opened for writing or mutated.
verified_controls.no_Lean_or_process_invocation: Exporter imports pathlib/base64/hashlib/io/json/tarfile. No Lean, leanchecker, subprocess, shell or process-launch call exists; compiler binaries are only hashed.
verified_controls.wrapper_binding: Wrapper fetches the exact exporter Git blob, verifies 7859 bytes, its SHA256 and Git object SHA, then compiles/executes that verified Python text with SOURCE_TEXT set to the same text. Thus archived EXPORTER.py is the verified source. The Python compile call is not a Lean invocation.
verified_controls.bounded_transport: Archive is created entirely in BytesIO with safe relative unique member names and asserted smaller than 1000000 bytes before metadata/base64 are printed.
verified_controls.accounting: Archive manifest, binding receipt and stdout explicitly record zero source recompilations, zero kernel replays and zero new manuscript credit. No new receiver or whole-standard-import proof claim is made.
